title: Incremental SVD for Large-Scale Dynamic Matrices: Accuracy, Subspace Stability, Refresh Strategies, and Financial Factor-Based Risk Models
abstract: arXiv:2605.24514v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Return panels, covariances, and large feature matrices evolve one observation or entry at a time, yet downstream models require an up-to-date low-rank factorization $A_t \approx U_t \Sigma_t V_t^\top$ on every tick - a regime where a full singular value decomposition (SVD) is prohibitive and existing alternatives sacrifice singular vectors, singular values, or long-horizon stability. We present a metric-driven study of Brand-style incremental SVD, built around a unified engine that handles row appends, column appends, rank-1 entry updates, and metrics tracking. For rank-1 entry updates, we derive an explicit projection-based rule $U'\Sigma'(V')^\top = P_U(\widehat{A} + \delta\,e_ie_j^\top)P_V$ that keeps rank fixed while discarding only the out-of-subspace remainder quantifiably, turning Brand's rank-suppression heuristic into an operational scheme. translated_title: 面向大规模动态矩阵的增量式奇异值分解（SVD）：精度、子空间稳定性、刷新策略与基于因子的金融风险模型
translated_abstract: 收益率面板数据、协方差矩阵和大型特征矩阵会随着每一个观测值或条目的更新而不断演化，而下游模型则要求在每个时间点上都能获得最新的低秩分解 $A_t \approx U_t \Sigma_t V_t^\top$——在这种应用场景下，完整的奇异值分解（SVD）代价过高，而现有的替代方法往往要牺牲奇异向量、奇异值或长期稳定性。我们对Brand式增量SVD进行了一项以度量驱动的研究，构建了一个统一引擎，能够处理行追加、列追加、秩1条目更新以及指标跟踪。对于秩1条目更新，我们推导出了一个显式的基于投影的更新规则 $U'\Sigma'(V')^\top = P_U(\widehat{A} + \delta\,e_ie_j^\top)P_V$，该规则在保持秩不变的同时，仅以可量化的方式舍弃子空间之外的残差部分，从而将Brand的秩抑制启发式方法转化为一种可操作的方案。每次更新所舍弃部分的范数都能以极低的成本获得……
tldr: 本文提出一种以度量驱动的Brand式增量SVD统一引擎，针对秩1条目更新推导出显式投影规则，在保持秩不变的前提下可量化地舍弃子空间外残差，从而实现对大规模动态矩阵的实时低秩分解，并应用于金融因子风险模型。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a metric-driven unified engine for Brand-style incremental SVD, deriving an explicit projection rule for rank-1 entry updates that keeps the rank fixed while quantifiably discarding only out-of-subspace remainders, enabling real-time low-rank factorization of large-scale dynamic matrices with applications to financial factor-based risk models.
